Calculate Standardized Uptake Value (SUV) for PET Volumes

Source: R/modality-transforms.R
dicom_pet_suv.Rd

Computes SUV body weight ("bw"), lean body mass ("lbm", Janmahasatian 2005), or body surface area ("bsa", DuBois & DuBois) from a PET dicom_volume or path.

Usage

dicom_pet_suv(
  x,
  method = c("bw", "lbm", "bsa"),
  decay_correct = c("auto", "none", "force")
)

Arguments

x

A dicom_volume object or path to DICOM PET files.

method

SUV normalization method: "bw" (body weight, default), "lbm" (lean body mass), or "bsa" (body surface area).

decay_correct

Decay correction handling: "auto" (default, uses SeriesTime or AcquisitionTime with radiopharmaceutical start time if CorrectedImage indicates decay correction), "none", or "force".

Value

A dicom_volume object with voxel values converted to SUV (units "g/ml" for "bw" and "lbm", or "cm2/ml" for "bsa"), updated metadata, and appended provenance.

Examples

out_dir <- tempfile("pet_demo_")
dicom_synthesize(out_dir = out_dir, modality = "PT", dims = c(16L, 16L, 2L))
vol <- read_dicom_volume(out_dir)
suv_vol <- dicom_pet_suv(vol, method = "bw")
suv_vol
#> <dicom_volume [PT] 16x16x2 | coord=LPS | units=g/ml>
#>   spacing: (1, 1, 2.5) mm | origin: (-16, -16, 0) mm
#>   frame_meta: 2 row(s) | provenance: 2 step(s)
unlink(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
